verdicts.reason: A buries the CTA: 'RSVP Free' is a tiny pill the same size as the badges. The wordmark is broken by a dot ('SOLST CE'), the italic subtitle is squeezed into a narrow column, and the gap between the date and time looks arbitrary. The fine print and the can are crammed into the right edge. B has a clearer left-to-right flow, with a one-line headline and a prominent RSVP button. However, the can graphic collides with the RSVP button, the placeholder box for the missing asset is enlarged and very noticeable, and the subtitle wraps awkwardly into a centred second line.
